description: Creating Comparability among European Neighbourhoods to Enable the Transition of District Energy Infrastructures towards Positive Energy Districts is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Axel Bruck, Ardak Akhatova (Instituto Tecnológico de Canarias). The aim of the this raster file is to allow comparability of districts across Europe, to support energy transformation in urban areas. Comparability will allow to transfer knowledge between district energy renovation projects. This dataset combines different raster files from the Hotmaps project. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
